summary: Attempt 2 of Owner amendment A0016 (layer CONTRACT; targets T073, T083, T084, T101), repairing exactly the three findings independent review-001 required and changing nothing else. (1) HISTORY ATTRIBUTION: todo/phases/P08-operations-and-web/T084.md line 13 no longer says the two further P08 web-module rows in ARCHITECTURE.md section 2.2 were recorded 'since A0014'; the clause now reads 'and records two further P08 web-module rows outside that triple', so the paragraph describes the section as it now stands without claiming a specification history the repository does not record. The T087 row (docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md:160) and the T088 row (:161) were recorded by A0012 (candidate commit 2b64df7034965ab78146204e7681008d74a760f6, measured with git blame on those lines and with git log -S 'robinhood_lp.web.runs' and -S 'robinhood_lp.web.backtest_result'); A0014 added only the T105-T108 successor rows and the transition paragraph at :171, and A0014 did not touch docs/spec/product/WEB_CONSOLE.md at all. (2) LINE CITATIONS: this attempt's record carries re-measured positions for ARCHITECTURE.md section 2.2 - T105 successor row :155, T107 successor row :157, T073 row :159, T087 row :160, T088 row :161 - and names the attempt-1 record's :133/:135, :137 and :155/:156 as the stale A0013-era numbers it replaces. (3) OCCURRENCE ARITHMETIC: the record states the measured count of thirteen remaining predecessor occurrences in the edited contracts - six in T073 (three `T063` and three `T066`), three in T083 (three `T066`) and four in T084 (four `T063`), measured with grep -o - instead of the attempt-1 undercount 'three in T073, three in T083 and four in T084'; the substantive claim of that sentence is unchanged and true, since every remaining occurrence is a legacy-only rendering or a prohibition. The amendment's content is otherwise that of attempt 1: T073 depends on T105 and T107 and shows only current registry-bound evidence and candidate identity, fails closed on an absent, mismatched or downgraded artifact, and keeps legacy artifacts historical and visibly non-current while the pool, token and paper authorization order is unchanged; T083 depends on T107 and its dossier resolves the released candidate only to a registry-bound lock, keeps old locks immutable, byte-identical and unpromotable, and blocks rather than falls back on a mismatch or unavailable revision; T084 depends on T105, displays the registered strategy identity and the schema/registry revision the manifest records without inventing, substituting or rewriting them, and reconciles its P08 console-scope paragraph and acceptance with ARCHITECTURE.md section 2.2 as it now stands, claiming no surface that section assigns to T087 or T088; T101 depends on T105 and T069 and assembles its panel and labels only from the declared run's validated manifests, preserving source checksums, dataset, run, member and registry identity and refusing incompatible revisions, failed or cancelled runs and legacy input. Resolved: A0014:T073:use-current-evidence-and-candidate, A0014:T083:consume-registry-bound-candidate-lock, A0014:T084:present-current-manifest-provenance, A0013:T084:legacy, A0014:T101:assemble-panel-from-current-run-manifests, A0013:T101:legacy. The attempt-1 record todo/amendments/A0016/planner-001.json stays byte-identical: a CONTRACT amendment may change only its four target contracts and todo/config.yaml (tools/workflow/core.py:1707-1716 refuses every other changed path), so the prior attempt's record is immutable history; it is corrected here, which is the only lawful treatment, and the correction is disclosed in this summary, in the rationale and in impact_assessment.specification.
rationale: Owner direction executed inside the CONTRACT layer, inside the four named targets only, each edited contract carrying its four dependency fields and nothing else outside it, with the three review-001 findings repaired. T073 (todo/phases/P07-risk-and-paper/T073.md): T063 and T066 are replaced by their successors T105 and T107 in Dependencies and in every normative reference; the authorization views now read the current T105 manifest and reports and the current T107 candidate lock with the registered strategy identity, strategy version, registry revision and parameter-schema identity it freezes; a T063 manifest or T066 lock may appear only as an explicitly historical, non-current artifact and is never copied into a new authorization; an absent, mismatched or downgraded current manifest or candidate lock fails closed; acceptance adds positive current-evidence display and negative legacy, mismatch and downgrade cases; Must not forbids treating a legacy artifact or an absent, mismatched or downgraded current artifact as authorization evidence; and the three journeys, their write path, the pool/token/paper authorization order, the P07 entry-gate clause and the bounded-scope clause are unchanged (closes A0014:T073:use-current-evidence-and-candidate). T083 (todo/phases/P08-operations-and-web/T083.md): T066 is replaced by T107 in Dependencies; readme-style Deliverables text is added stating that the dossier's experiment and candidate evidence comes only from the current registry-bound T107 lock and names the released candidate version, registered strategy identity, registry/schema revision, content hash and actor; a T066 lock stays immutable, byte-identical, never rewritten or backfilled and never promoted; acceptance adds the current-lock resolution case and the old-format, content-hash or revision mismatch and unavailable-revision refusals; Must not forbids promoting a legacy, absent, mismatched or downgraded lock; and the frozen deliverable list, clean-room reproduction, checkbox-to-evidence and issue-severity clauses (T083.md:31-32) are preserved (closes A0014:T083:consume-registry-bound-candidate-lock). T084 (todo/phases/P08-operations-and-web/T084.md): T063 is replaced by T105 in Dependencies and in the manifest-provenance sentence; the 'Console scope in P08' paragraph no longer reads as if T084-T086 were the whole P08 web surface - it records that ARCHITECTURE.md section 2.2 assigns robinhood_lp.web to T084-T086 and records two further P08 web-module rows owned by T087 (WEB-PAGE-012) and T088 (WEB-PAGE-013), which the paragraph and the acceptance place explicitly outside this task's acceptance without claiming ownership of them - and, repaired in this attempt, it no longer attributes those two rows to A0014, so it describes the section as it now stands; deliverables and acceptance require the displayed provenance to include the registered strategy identity and the schema/registry revision the manifest records, a current-and-legacy render that distinguishes them, a mismatch that fails closed, and no free-text or inferred substitution; Must not adds the matching substitution and legacy-presentation prohibitions; T063 thus disappears as a normative input while remaining named only as the legacy artifact (closes A0014:T084:present-current-manifest-provenance and A0013:T084:legacy). T101 (todo/phases/P10-research-and-models/T101.md): T063 is replaced by T105 and T069 is added, so the panel is assembled only from the validated manifest set of the T069 run the configuration names, with a new deliverable bullet binding every sample to its run identity, dataset version, member identity, registry revision and source checksums and refusing manifests outside the declared run, members with a disagreeing registry or schema revision, failed or cancelled runs and legacy pre-registry manifests; acceptance adds panel provenance plus deduplication and the incompatible-revision, failed/cancelled-run and legacy-rejection cases, the boundary list gains the same cases, Must not forbids merging or backfilling incompatible or unsuccessful or legacy input and inferring an unrecorded identity, and the T068 registry identity is reached transitively through T069 and T105 (both declare T068, measured) so no redundant direct edge is added (closes A0014:T101:assemble-panel-from-current-run-manifests and A0013:T101:legacy). Every other recorded impact stays open and untouched, and this amendment names them: A0013:T063:legacy, A0013:T064:legacy, A0013:T066:legacy, A0013:T067:legacy (the four retirement-route findings, which no consumer re-pointing can close), A0013:T071:legacy, A0013:T072:legacy, A0013:T082:legacy, A0013:T085:legacy, A0013:T086:legacy, A0013:T091:legacy, A0013:T096:legacy, A0013:T102:legacy, A0013:T103:legacy, A0013:T104:legacy, A0014:T087:read-current-manifest-coverage, A0014:T088:reconcile-current-result-checksums, A0014:T096:include-successor-final-evidence and A0014:T102:consume-schema-bound-robustness (18 open impacts before this amendment, 24 minus the six it closes; recomputed from todo/amendments/*/impacts.json and confirmed with python -m tools.workflow status in the main checkout, which reports 24 open impacts of which exactly these six touch T073, T083, T084 or T101). No new conflict is created: after this change no ordinary PLANNED consumer remains on T063 (its consumers are the successor T105 and the APPROVED T064, which T106 replaces) or on T066 (its only consumer is the successor T107), which is what T105.md:54-59 and T107.md:45-48 require of later CONTRACT amendments, but retiring either predecessor stays a separate SUPERSEDE act and this amendment sets no superseded_by, status, attempt, evidence, commit, revision or review field. The thirteen remaining T063/T066 occurrences in the edited text are legacy-only prohibitions and renderings, not normative consumption: six in T073 (three `T063` and three `T066`, at T073.md:35-36, 54-55 and 68), three in T083 (three `T066`, at T083.md:23, 35 and 42) and four in T084 (four `T063`, at T084.md:48, 65, 75 and 83), measured with grep -o; T101 carries none. This corrects the attempt-1 record's sentence 'three in T073, three in T083 and four in T084', which undercounted T073 by omitting its three T066 tokens; review-001 confirmed that sentence's substantive claim, and only the arithmetic is repaired.

impact_assessment.security: No new permission, trust boundary, credential or secret surface is added. T073 remains the single Owner write boundary for pool selection, HOLD/LP approval and preliminary-paper authorization, and the new evidence and candidate views grant no authority: registry binding is not authorization and a legacy or mismatched artifact authorizes nothing. T083's lock evidence grants no live permission and cannot satisfy T094. T084 stays a read model that redacts secrets and cannot mutate domain state. T101's run, member and registry identity binding grants no execution authority. No secret, endpoint value or key material was read, printed or written anywhere in this amendment; the only files inspected were contracts, review and amendment records and specification documents.
